ar: وَصَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى أٰلِهٖ وَأَدْخِلْنَا حَظِيْرَةَ الْقُدْسِ فِيْ جُمْلَةِ الْأَحْبَابِ .
tr: Wa ṣalli wa sallim wa bārik `alā Sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa `alā Ālihī, Wa adkhil nā haẓīrata ‘l-qudsi fī jumlati ‘l-aḥbāb.
en: and send prayers upon, salute and bless our Master Muḥammad and his Family and enter us in the Sanctuary among the most beloved group!

ar: وَصَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى أٰلِهٖ سَائِرِ الْأَنْبِيَاءِ وَ الْأَصْفِيَاءِ وَ الْأٓلِ وَ الْأَصْحَابِ .
tr: Wa ṣalli wa sallim wa bārik `alā Sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa `alā Ālihī, Wa `alā sā’iri ‘l-Anbiyā’i wa ‘l-Aṣfiyā’i wa ‘l-Āli wa ‘l-Aṣḥāb.
en: and send prayers upon, salute and bless our Master Muḥammad and all the Prophets, Purified, Folk and Companions!
blocks.review: Source prints أٰلِهٖ سَائِرِ with no وَعَلَى before سَائِرِ although the transliteration has 'Wa `alā sā’iri'; transcribed as printed. الْأٓلِ: lam-alif printed with sukūn, hamza and madda; transcribed as أٓ.
